portal-latece.title: LATECE Portal
portal-latece.description: Official institutional portal for the Assistive Technology Laboratory at UFRN's Center for Education (LATECE), built under the FINEP-funded TECincluir initiative (2024 grant). A dedicated hub for research, training, and outreach in Assistive Technology, engineered from the ground up for accessibility and digital inclusion.

sections.title: About the project
paragraphs: TECincluir (Intersectoral and Interinstitutional Network of Multi-user Assistive Technology Laboratories) is funded by FINEP under the MCTI/FINEP Cross-Cutting Assistive Technology Public Call (Sisassistiva-MCTI, 2024).

As part of this initiative, I designed and built the institutional portal for LATECE (Assistive Technology Laboratory at UFRN's Center for Education), serving as a hub for research, academic training, and knowledge dissemination while adhering strictly to UFRN's engineering, design, and security standards.

items.label: General coordination
items.text: Prof. Márcia Denise Pletsch (UFRRJ), with associate coordination by Izadora Souza (UFRRJ).

items.label: Partner institutions
items.text: CITEI (UFRRJ), LaTAI-INT (National Institute of Technology), LATECE (UFRN Center for Education), and LAR-UERN (UERN Robotics Learning Lab).

items.label: Core mission
items.text: Develop and validate assistive technology solutions, advance applied research, and foster the inclusion of people with disabilities.

items.label: Public portal
items.text: Showcase of the lab, research team, equipment, academic publications, and a full news system with filtering and pagination.

items.label: Admin dashboard
items.text: Content management system featuring JWT-based authentication and role-based access control.

items.label: Visual identity
items.text: Fully responsive interface across desktop, tablet, and mobile, aligned with UFRN's institutional design system.

items.label: vLIBRAS
items.text: Native integration with the Brazilian Sign Language (Libras) translation suite.

items.label: High contrast
items.text: Dedicated high-contrast theme for enhanced readability.

items.label: Dynamic typography
items.text: On-the-fly font scaling via keyboard shortcuts and toolbar controls.

items.label: Screen readers & keyboard
items.text: Full screen-reader compatibility, semantic ARIA attributes, and keyboard-first navigation compliant with WCAG 2.1.

items.description: Focused on software architecture, designing and structuring scalable, maintainable systems. Implementing architectural patterns such as MVC/MVVM, building standardized boilerplates, authoring technical documentation (ADRs and UML diagrams), and conducting code reviews to uphold engineering quality.

Bridged the gap between product, engineering, and clients by translating complex technical concepts into clear, structured documentation. Led requirements gathering, authored system and API guides, documented architecture and user flows, and produced enablement materials for both developers and end users.
Worked within the Information Technology department at the Public Prosecutor's Office of Rio Grande do Norte (MPRN), supporting technical operations, user support, and internal digital workflows.

Undergraduate degree in Computer Science. Alongside building a strong foundation in algorithms and software engineering, served as Vice President of the Academic Directory, strengthening leadership, organization, and executive communication skills.
